subject: Architecture sync: plan for moving inference off current provider

From: Tom Huang <tom.huang@acme-analytics.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Architecture deep-dive for moving off current inference provider

Hi Evelyn,

Hope you're doing well — we're starting a formal evaluation to move our inference stack off our current hosted provider and back in-house / to a new vendor. Before committing to a PoC we want a technical deep-dive with your solutions and infra team to validate latency profiles, KV cache behavior, and deployment/rollout patterns (canary, fallback).

Suggested attendees from our side:
- Tom Huang (Platform lead)
- Maya Ortiz (ML infra)
- Procurement (looped)

We can be flexible but would prefer a 60–90 minute slot the week of Apr 18. I've attached a short infra snapshot that outlines our current setup (GPU fleet, request QPS, peak token rates).

Attachments: acme_infra_snapshot.pdf

Thanks — can your team propose a couple of windows?

Best,
Tom Huang
Platform Lead, Acme Analytics
+1 415-555-0198

Hi Tom — thanks for the note and the infra snapshot, that was helpful. We'd love to run a focused architecture review and bring our runtime/product engineering folks to walk through:

- how Redwood handles continuous batching / prefix caching for low p99 latency
- model pinning and automated fallback routes during a deployment
- quantization and throughput/latency tradeoffs for your reported GPU classes

Proposed times (PDT):
- Tue Apr 19, 10:00–11:30
- Wed Apr 20, 14:00–15:30

If neither works we can do Thu Apr 21 morning. I'm CC'ing Karthik (runtime lead) and Marissa (solutions) to scope an internal agenda and prep a short PoC plan — I'll attach an initial draft.

Attachments: redwood_poc_plan_v1.docx

Would you prefer Zoom or a calendar invite with a Teams link? Also let me know the names of any engineers who need access to the PoC docs ahead of time.

Cheers,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

- Wed Apr 20, 10:00–11:30 (PDT) OR
- Thu Apr 21, 09:00–10:30 (PDT)

Also adding Jonas Weber to the thread — Jonas handles our deployment/ops runbooks and should be on the call.

Agenda items I want to make sure we cover (short):
- traffic shaping & routing: how we implement regional fallbacks
- KV cache warmup and cross-replica cache behavior for short-lived sessions
- expected p50/p95/p99 for the model family you indicated in the snapshot (NVIDIA A10x equivalent)

On attachments: I'll include a short checklist in the invite for pre-reads.
